items.gold_nlq: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, e.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, d.CITY, d.STATE, d.POSTAL_CODE FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS d JOIN FCLT_ROOMS a ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY b ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY c ON b.DLC_KEY = c.DLC_KEY JOIN BUILDINGS e ON e.BUILDING_KEY = d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE lower(c.DLC_NAME) = lower('History') AND d.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

iterations.nlq: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
iterations.generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,
  fba.CITY AS city,
  fba.STATE AS state,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY od
  ON od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh

JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba

items.gold_nlq: List the unique course instructor names, course titles, and the amount of material for each course instructor key and the key of subject offered.

  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS AMOUNT_OF_MATERIAL
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

GROUP BY
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,

items.gold_nlq: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
items.gold_sql: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id) FROM cis_course_catalog ccc JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME;

iterations.nlq: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
iterations.generated_sql:
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses_offered
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso
  ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

iterations.nlq: For each building name, how many distinct courses offered by the Center for International Studies are held in that building?
iterations.generated_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_course_count
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS cis
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso

items.gold_nlq: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?

iterations.nlq: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
iterations.generated_sql:

  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r

JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE

    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

         mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
instructor_metrics AS (
  SELECT
      lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
      MIN(CASE
            WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)

      MAX(CASE
            WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)

      SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students

    ON sp.FULL_NAME = lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  JOIN keeper_members km
    ON km.MIT_ID = sp.MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY
      lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
)

JOIN member_lists ml

ORDER BY
    im.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,

    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

  SELECT

  FROM latest_bldg lb

    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,

  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba

  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP BY fba.BUILDING_KEY
),

    SUM(CASE WHEN bb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buildings_not_subdivisions,

WITH
dlc_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    fo.DLC_NAME
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    SUM(CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_building_heights
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
),
supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  db.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  db.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name,
  COALESCE(sa.total_floors, 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  COALESCE(sa.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(sa.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees,
  COALESCE(sa.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights
FROM dlc_base db
LEFT JOIN space_agg sa
  ON sa.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN supervisor_agg sva
  ON sva.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY db.DLC_KEY;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS hr_departments,
  MAX(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_gross_square_footage,
  MAX(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_assignable_square_footage,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR fb.DATE_BUILT = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(fb.DATE_BUILT, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
      WHEN fb.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(fb.DATE_BUILT AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS built_year
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY;

WITH faculty_courses AS (
  SELECT
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
),
faculty_krb AS (
  SELECT
    e.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    e.KRB_NAME AS krb_name
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  JOIN faculty_courses fc
    ON fc.mit_id = e.MIT_ID
  WHERE e.KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
list_members_10 AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = 10
),
faculty_list_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fk.mit_id,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM faculty_krb fk
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = fk.krb_name
  JOIN list_members_10 lm
    ON lm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fls.mit_id) AS faculty_in_list,
  SUM(fc.course_count) AS courses_associated_with_those_faculty
FROM faculty_list_subscriptions fls
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN faculty_courses fc
  ON fc.mit_id = fls.mit_id
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY
  faculty_in_list DESC,
  courses_associated_with_those_faculty DESC,
  mailing_list_name;

1) Include lists **only** based on the **Moira group indicator** (do **not** require any other “mailing list” indicator). When counting members, **do not add any extra filter that removes rows with missing member values**—just count **distinct members** as they appear. For each combination of **mailing list name + owner + owner type + member visibility**, count the **distinct** members.  
Member visibility must be labeled **“Public Members”** only when it is exactly public (**Y**), **“Hidden Members”** only when it is exactly not public (**N**), otherwise leave it null.

2) Then create **rollup-style results** for each mailing list by rolling up **(mailing list name, member visibility)** so that, for each mailing list, you have:
- one row per visibility label with the member count equal to the **sum of the per-(owner, owner type) distinct-member counts** for that visibility, and
- one additional row for the mailing list overall where the visibility label is **null**, with the member count equal to the **sum across all visibility labels** for that mailing list.  
Exclude only those rollup rows whose **summed** member count is **0**.

3) Finally, for each rollup row, attach owner information by pairing it with the **distinct (owner, owner type) pairs** that exist for that same mailing list, producing separate rows per owner pair, while **keeping every rollup row even if no owner pair exists** (the rollup member counts must not change).

Return the results sorted by mailing list name and then by the visibility label.

      WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
      WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS visibility_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
    AND UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%'
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
    CASE
      WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
      WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members'
      ELSE NULL
    END
),
rollup AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    visibility_label,
    SUM(distinct_member_count) AS member_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    visibility_label

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    NULL AS visibility_label,
    SUM(distinct_member_count) AS member_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    mlo.OWNER,
    mlo.OWNER_TYPE
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
    AND UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%'
)
SELECT
  r.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  o.OWNER,
  o.OWNER_TYPE,
  r.visibility_label,
  r.member_count
FROM rollup r
LEFT JOIN owners o
  ON o.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = r.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE r.member_count <> 0
ORDER BY
  r.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  r.visibility_label;

WITH bio_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%Biology%'
),
bio_with_level AS (
  SELECT
    bs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    bs.COURSE_NUMBER,
    bs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    bs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    bs.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    bs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    scd.COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM bio_subjects bs
  LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
    ON scd.COURSE = bs.COURSE_NUMBER
),
cluster_avg AS (
  SELECT
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster
  FROM bio_subjects
  GROUP BY CLUSTER_TYPE
),
tip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_material_record_count
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
lib_agg AS (
  SELECT
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_library_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS unique_library_isbns
  FROM TIP_MATERIAL tm
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = tm.ISBN
  GROUP BY tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
lib_by_subject AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(la.unique_library_titles, 0)) AS unique_library_titles,
    SUM(COALESCE(la.unique_library_isbns, 0)) AS unique_library_isbns
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  LEFT JOIN lib_agg la
    ON la.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
)
SELECT
  bwl.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  bwl.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  bwl.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  bwl.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  SUM(bwl.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollments,
  ca.avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  SUM(COALESCE(ta.unique_course_materials, 0)) AS unique_course_materials,
  AVG(ta.avg_new_shelf_price) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(ta.avg_used_shelf_price) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  SUM(COALESCE(ta.total_tip_material_record_count, 0)) AS total_tip_material_record_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(lbs.unique_library_titles, 0)) AS unique_library_titles,
  SUM(COALESCE(lbs.unique_library_isbns, 0)) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM bio_with_level bwl
LEFT JOIN cluster_avg ca
  ON ca.CLUSTER_TYPE = bwl.CLUSTER_TYPE
LEFT JOIN tip_agg ta
  ON ta.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = bwl.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN lib_by_subject lbs
  ON lbs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = bwl.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY

iterations.nlq: Group courses offered by the **Biology department only** (the department name must be exactly “Biology”) by cluster type and course level. For each department + course title + cluster type + course level group, report total enrollment and the **average enrollment for that cluster type across all Biology courses**. Also include TIP information by matching TIP details to the course using the course’s subject identifier: count distinct course material titles, average new and used prices, and sum the TIP material record counts. For library reserves, match library reserve items to the course using the same subject identifier (not by ISBN), and count distinct library titles and distinct library ISBNs. Order the results by department, then course title, then cluster type.

WITH bio_courses AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_ID,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrollment
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
  GROUP BY
    sos.SUBJECT_ID,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE
),
course_levels AS (
  SELECT
    scd.COURSE AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    MAX(scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  GROUP BY scd.COURSE
),
cluster_avg AS (
  SELECT
    bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(bc.total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_cluster_bio
  FROM bio_courses bc
  GROUP BY bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
),
tip_by_subject AS (
  SELECT
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TITLE) AS distinct_material_titles,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS sum_tip_record_count
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID
),
library_by_subject AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS distinct_library_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS distinct_library_isbns
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  'Biology' AS department,
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  cl.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  bc.total_enrollment,
  ca.avg_enrollment_cluster_bio AS avg_enrollment_for_cluster_type_across_biology,
  COALESCE(tbs.distinct_material_titles, 0) AS distinct_course_material_titles,
  tbs.avg_new_shelf_price,
  tbs.avg_used_shelf_price,
  COALESCE(tbs.sum_tip_record_count, 0) AS sum_tip_material_record_counts,
  COALESCE(lbs.distinct_library_titles, 0) AS distinct_library_titles,
  COALESCE(lbs.distinct_library_isbns, 0) AS distinct_library_isbns
FROM bio_courses bc
LEFT JOIN course_levels cl
  ON cl.COURSE_NUMBER = bc.COURSE_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN cluster_avg ca
  ON ca.CLUSTER_TYPE = bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
LEFT JOIN tip_by_subject tbs
  ON tbs.SUBJECT_ID = bc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN library_by_subject lbs
  ON lbs.SUBJECT_ID = bc.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY
  department,
  course_title,
  cluster_type;

items.gold_nlq: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
items.gold_sql: WITH HASSAttributes AS (SELECT cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, cc.SUBJECT_ID, cc.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG cc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cc.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON cc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN DEPARTMENT_NAME END) AS num_degree_granting, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM HASSAttributes GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

iterations.nlq: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.

SELECT
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS hass_attribute_name,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS hass_attribute_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects,
  AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_units,
  SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS num_degree_granting_departments,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ccc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
GROUP BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
ORDER BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

Return the columns in this order: room number, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, major use, term code, course level, then the three metrics.

For each such group, report:
1) the count of distinct subjects meeting there,
2) the count of distinct meeting times there, and
3) the sum of units across all offerings in that group (do not treat missing units as zero; just add up the units that are present).

Only include offerings where the room number is present and the meeting time is present (null only; do not exclude empty text). Only include cases where the room number can be matched to a room record that has both a building and a room-usage classification; however, still keep the row even if the building address (city/state) is missing and even if the course level is missing.

Sort by term code, then by total units (highest to lowest), then by room number.

  c.MEET_PLACE AS room_number,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  a.CITY AS building_city,
  a.STATE AS building_state,
  r.AREA AS area,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  mu.MAJOR_USE AS `major use`,
  c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subject_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.MEET_TIME) AS distinct_meeting_time_count,
  SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY = r.MAJOR_USE_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd

WHERE c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY

  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  r.AREA,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  c.TERM_CODE,
  total_units_sum DESC,
  c.MEET_PLACE;

Also show the library term code from the library reserves details for that same ISBN by matching the TIP ISBN to the library reserves catalog ISBN, and then taking the term code only from the library reserves detail records that are linked to that matching catalog record; keep the TIP material even if there is no matching library record, and if there are multiple linked library-reserves detail records with different term codes, show one row per term code.

Indicate availability as “Available in Library” only when there is a matching library reserves catalog record for that same TIP ISBN; otherwise show “Not Available in Library”.

In addition, for each TIP ISBN show the number of distinct instructors associated with that ISBN across all library reserves detail records (count distinct instructors per ISBN, not separately per term code).

Also show two library-reserves totals: (1) for the TIP material’s department, the total number of distinct ISBNs that are available in the library reserves for that department, where “available” means the ISBN appears in a library reserves catalog record that has at least one linked library reserves detail record, and the department for this total must come from the library reserves subject offering linked from those detail records; and (2) the total number of distinct ISBNs available in the library reserves across all departments using the same “catalog record with at least one linked detail record” rule.

If a TIP ISBN has no matching instructor count, or the TIP department has no matching department total, show 0 for those counts. Order the results by department name and then TIP material title.

WITH
tip_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
      tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
      tm.TITLE AS tip_title,
      tm.ISBN AS tip_isbn
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
lib_isbn_term AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
      lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
      lrmd.TERM_CODE AS term_code
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
),
lib_isbn_instructor_cnt AS (
  SELECT
      lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS distinct_instructors
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_ISBN
),
lib_dept_isbn_totals AS (
  SELECT
      lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS dept_distinct_isbns_available
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
lib_all_isbn_total AS (
  SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS all_distinct_isbns_available
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
)
SELECT
    tb.dept_name AS department_name,
    tb.tip_title AS tip_material_title,
    tb.tip_isbn AS isbn,
    lit.term_code AS library_term_code,
    CASE
      WHEN lit.isbn IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available in Library'
      ELSE 'Not Available in Library'
    END AS availability,
    COALESCE(liic.distinct_instructors, 0) AS distinct_instructors_for_isbn,
    COALESCE(ldit.dept_distinct_isbns_available, 0) AS dept_distinct_isbns_available_in_library,
    COALESCE(lait.all_distinct_isbns_available, 0) AS all_distinct_isbns_available_in_library
FROM tip_base tb
LEFT JOIN lib_isbn_term lit
  ON lit.isbn = tb.tip_isbn
LEFT JOIN lib_isbn_instructor_cnt liic
  ON liic.isbn = tb.tip_isbn
LEFT JOIN lib_dept_isbn_totals ldit
  ON ldit.dept_name = tb.dept_name
CROSS JOIN lib_all_isbn_total lait
ORDER BY
    tb.dept_name,
    tb.tip_title;

    bl.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    bl.BUILDING_USE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_orgs
  FROM b_latest bl
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bl.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, bl.BUILDING_USE
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_USE,
    b.num_buildings,
    b.gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(r.num_rooms,0) AS num_rooms,
    COALESCE(r.num_orgs,0) AS num_orgs
  FROM b_agg b
  LEFT JOIN r_agg r
    ON r.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
   AND r.BUILDING_USE = b.BUILDING_USE
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_group,
    d.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    d.BUILDING_USE,
    d.num_buildings,
    d.gross_sqft,
    d.num_rooms,
    d.num_orgs
  FROM detail d

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS BUILDING_USE,
    SUM(num_buildings),
    SUM(gross_sqft),
    SUM(num_rooms),
    SUM(num_orgs)
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    3 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS BUILDING_USE,
    SUM(num_buildings),
    SUM(gross_sqft),
    SUM(num_rooms),
    SUM(num_orgs)
  FROM detail
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN sort_group = 1
      THEN CASE
             WHEN @prev_own = OWNERSHIP_TYPE THEN NULL
             ELSE (SELECT @prev_own := OWNERSHIP_TYPE)
           END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 1 THEN BUILDING_USE ELSE NULL END AS usage_type,
  num_buildings AS number_of_buildings,
  FORMAT(gross_sqft, 0) AS gross_square_footage,
  num_rooms AS number_of_rooms,
  num_orgs AS number_of_associated_organizations
FROM (
  SELECT
    ar.*,
    CASE
      WHEN sort_group = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN sort_group = 2 THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END AS sort_level,
    CASE
      WHEN sort_group = 1 THEN 0
      WHEN sort_group = 2 THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END AS is_total
  FROM all_rows ar
) x
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_own := NULL) vars
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(x.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ''),
  x.is_total,
  x.BUILDING_USE;

SELECT
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  CONCAT(REPEAT(' ', GREATEST(CAST(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) - 1, 0)), o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS formatted_organization_name,
  CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.AREA), 0)), 0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(r.ROOM)), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.AREA), 0)), 0) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Cambridge-MIT Institute'
GROUP BY
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  o.ASSIGNABLE
ORDER BY
  CAST(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED),

    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY

  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,

  FROM base

    major_use_description,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area,

    0 AS is_grand_total
  FROM agg

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS assignable_status,
    NULL AS major_use_description,
    SUM(total_rooms) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(total_rooms), 0) AS avg_area,
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    0 AS is_grand_total
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY assignable_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS assignable_status,
    NULL AS major_use_description,
    SUM(total_rooms) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,

Include subtotals for each current status (the corresponding current status field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all current status (the corresponding current status field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the current status if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by current status and cluster type.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, cluster_type

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    current_status,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS current_status,
    'TOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN current_status = LAG(current_status) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE current_status WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'NON-CURRENT' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
        sort_level,
        cluster_type
    )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE current_status
  END AS current_status,
  cluster_type,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  CASE current_status WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'NON-CURRENT' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  sort_level,
  cluster_type;

Define the first-column label exactly like this:
- For regular rows: if the current-status flag is “Y”, label it “CURRENT”; otherwise label it “NON-CURRENT”.
- For the rollup row that summarizes all cluster types within a single current-status-flag value: label it “SUBTOTAL”.
- For the single rollup row that summarizes everything across both current-status-flag values and all cluster types: label it “TOTAL”.

Compute, for every regular row and every rollup row:
- the maximum and average term duration in days, where duration is the day difference between the term end date and term start date after parsing both dates from text in the day–abbreviated-month–two-digit-year format (for example, 05-Jan-24),
- the maximum units and the average units.

For “SUBTOTAL” and “TOTAL” rows, leave the cluster type blank.

Sort the results exactly in this order:
1) by the current-status flag value itself, with “Y” first and then all other values,
2) then by the first-column label in plain alphabetical order (so “CURRENT”, then “NON-CURRENT”, then “SUBTOTAL”, then “TOTAL”),
3) then by cluster type alphabetically.

Finally, in the displayed output only, if the first-column label is the same as the previous row’s first-column label under that same ordering, show it as blank (null) on the later row (apply this to all labels, including “SUBTOTAL” and “TOTAL”).

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS is_current_term,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
    DATEDIFF(
      STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(at.TERM_END_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'), '%d-%b-%y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'), '%d-%b-%y')
    ) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    is_current_term,
    cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY is_current_term, cluster_type WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    is_current_term,
    CASE
      WHEN is_current_term IS NULL AND cluster_type IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN is_current_term IS NOT NULL AND cluster_type IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN is_current_term = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NON-CURRENT'
    END AS label,
    CASE
      WHEN (is_current_term IS NULL AND cluster_type IS NULL) OR (is_current_term IS NOT NULL AND cluster_type IS NULL)
        THEN NULL
      ELSE cluster_type
    END AS cluster_type_display,
    max_term_duration_days,
    avg_term_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_units
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    label,
    cluster_type_display,
    max_term_duration_days,
    avg_term_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_units,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN is_current_term = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        is_current_term,
        label,
        cluster_type_display
    ) AS rn,
    LAG(label) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN is_current_term = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        is_current_term,
        label,
        cluster_type_display
    ) AS prev_label
  FROM labeled
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN label = prev_label THEN NULL ELSE label END AS label,
  cluster_type_display AS cluster_type,
  max_term_duration_days,
  avg_term_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_units
FROM ordered
ORDER BY rn;

  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso

    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    iss.SESSION_DATE,

    current_status,

    COUNT(*) AS iap_sessions,

        WHEN end_dt < start_dt THEN (TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_dt, end_dt) + 86400) / 86400

    SUM(iap_sessions) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(total_session_days) AS total_session_days,
    SUM(total_session_days) / NULLIF(SUM(iap_sessions), 0) AS avg_session_days,
    1 AS cluster_type
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS current_status,
    NULL AS session_name,
    SUM(iap_sessions) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(total_session_days) AS total_session_days,
    SUM(total_session_days) / NULLIF(SUM(iap_sessions), 0) AS avg_session_days,

  total_session_days,
  avg_session_days
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY
  CASE current_status WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 0 WHEN 'NOT CURRENT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  cluster_type,
  session_name;
